import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

import io
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def solve(data):
    df=pd.DataFrame(data['orders']); df['day']=pd.to_datetime(df['OrderDate']).dt.normalize(); revenue=df.groupby('day')['Amount'].sum(); days=pd.date_range(revenue.index.min(),revenue.index.max()); daily=revenue.reindex(days,fill_value=0); avg=daily.rolling(7,min_periods=1).mean(); return [{'date':day.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'moving_average':float(value)} for day,value in avg.items()]
